long_biography.plain_text:
Vagit Alekperov began on oil rigs in the Caspian Sea and rose through production management in western Siberia. As a senior Soviet oil official, he combined the Langepas, Urai and Kogalym enterprises into the platform that became Lukoil. The company developed under his leadership into a vertically integrated producer spanning exploration, extraction, refining and fuel distribution.

Alekperov served as Lukoil's president and held board leadership roles until resigning from both in 2022. He no longer has a documented executive or board position, but remains a substantial shareholder. Beyond the company, he established the Our Future Foundation to support social enterprises with financing, advice and wider development programs.
